# The TCB inventory (bead franken_lean-z8j.1.17): every function of the workspace's own
# crates that the linker keeps reachable from fln_kernel::check, measured from the
# crates/fln-conformance tcb-probe binary. Do not edit by hand; regenerate with
#   FLN_TCB_INVENTORY_WRITE=1 cargo test -p fln-conformance --test tcb_inventory
# which rewrites this file from a fresh measurement and keeps the `budget` line.
# The test re-measures on every run and fails if this file disagrees in either
# direction. Limits are in crates/fln-conformance/src/tcb_inventory.rs.
# `budget` is declared by hand, not measured: the ceiling on functions outside
# fln_kernel that check may reach, the trusted code the 12 KLOC line covenant on
# crates/fln-kernel/src does not count. Raising it is a reviewed decision.
